experiment.name: Operation Biathlon
experiment.research_question: Can a previously established recommendation system develop a measurable new topic preference that does not reflect the account owner's existing interests?

config.subject: Founder's existing personal Instagram account (algorithm NOT reset)

checkpoints.T0: Two baseline sessions of 50 Reels each

observation_rules: Observe only the Reels recommendation surface (desktop web).
Do not count search results or deliberately opened creator profiles.
Mark identifiable ads and followed-account content; they are excluded from the primary metric.
config.hypothesis_note: The 20% target is a research hypothesis, not an expected or guaranteed result.

profile.name: EXP-001 Biathlon
profile.description: Target information environment for Operation Biathlon: at least 20% direct biathlon content on Instagram Reels.

topics.label: Biathlon
topics.description: DIRECT: biathlon competitions; biathlon athletes in a biathlon context; biathlon skiing and shooting; Biathlon World Cup and IBU content.

topics.label: Cross-country skiing
topics.description: ADJACENT: cross-country skiing without biathlon shooting.

topics.label: Winter sports / Winter Olympics
topics.description: ADJACENT: winter sports and Winter Olympics content without a specific biathlon focus.
